series.name: Northbound / north-east (towards Parramatta CBD)
series.evidence: Consecutive replacements at the same spot with no overlap; all three directions have the 08:00 weekday peak and are the smaller direction (192<201, 1088<1087, 1857<1859); site total / adjacent site 191 total is 0.93-0.96 under every counter, so levels are comparable.

series.name: Southbound / south-west
series.evidence: Consecutive replacements with no overlap; all three have the 07:00 weekday peak and are the larger direction; site/191 ratio stable at ~0.95 across counters 197, 299 and 391.

summary: Site 190 on the Parramatta River north path ran three consecutive Metrocount piezos (197, 299, 391); they track the adjacent site 191 at a steady 0.93-0.96 ratio, so each direction forms one continuous series. Counter 299 failed from 2026-03-01 until its replacement on 2026-04-22, so both directions are set missing for that period. The genuine outages (2019-04-29 to 2019-09-30, 2022-05-16 to 2022-05-18, 2024-12-24 to 2025-01-03, 2025-10-20) are handled correctly by zero_outage, but its flags on heavy-rain days are restored because site 191 recorded the same near-zero counts.
